name: Necromancer: Tears of Lordaeron restores mana and Runic Power on direct critical strikes (#10007)
contract: Tears of Lordaeron 705752 (CharacterAdvancement 29196, class 23) reads 'Direct critical strikes regenerate
$705753s2% of your maximum mana and $705753s1% of your maximum runic power.' Proc spell 705753 has two
SPELL_EFFECT_ENERGIZE_PCT (137) effects on the caster: effect 0 MiscValue 6 (Runic Power) BasePoints 8 +
DieSides 1 = 9%, effect 1 MiscValue 0 (mana) BasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = 3%. Lichfrost 801722 deals direct
Frost damage. With spell critical strike rating far above 100%, every Lichfrost hit is critical, so after
learning the talent one hit must log a 705753 mana energize of 3% of maximum mana and a Runic Power energize
of 9% of the 1000 maximum. Without the talent the same critical hit logs no 705753 energize.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Necromancer has a mana pool
SETUP: Lichfrost lands on the golem
CONTROL: no Tears of Lordaeron energize without the talent
DISCRIMINATING: the critical hit restores 3% of maximum mana
The critical hit restores 9% of maximum Runic Power
